glosses: Pleasant; pleasing, bringing enjoyment, satisfaction, or pleasure.

examples.text: What? a higher delight to be drawn from the sight / Of fish full of life and of glee? / What a noodle you are! ’tis delightfuller far / To kill them than let them go free!

O, Joy! quicker than fire! O, Hope of things! / O, gracious gladness mighty with delight! / O, subtle sweet, delightfuler than might! / Ah, me, no fiercer laughing unction springs / From the fair Hope of things!

examples.text: Princezna, kterou Honza vysvobodil od draka a do níž se na smrt zamiloval, byla neobyčejně krásná.

Il y a de bons mariages, mais il n’y en a point de délicieux.

glosses: Qui est charmant, en parlant d’une personne ou de ses attributs.

examples.text: C’était bien un couple délicieux de volupté, de grâces, d’abandon lascif, de pudeur craintive.
